title: Next-generation template editor
context: Postmark's next-generation template editor, a 10-month initiative that needed cross-functional alignment from the start.
role: Led the technical discovery, cross-functional alignment and end-to-end decision-making, and handled executive communication.
result: Carried the initiative through its full lifecycle, from first discovery to delivery.

title: Billing platform migration
context: Migrating the billing platform behind Postmark, a transactional email product.
role: Technical lead and subject-matter expert: system design, ticket breakdown and cross-team alignment.
result: Turned the migration into a designed, ticketed plan and onboarded contractors to deliver it.

title: Legacy platform modernization
context: A legacy Rails 4 and jQuery monolith whose data tables took over 20 seconds to load.
role: Spearheaded the move to a Rails 6 API with a React frontend and rebuilt the data table architecture: no more N+1 queries, refined indexing and caching.
result: Load times dropped from over 20 seconds to under 8.

title: Customer Support tooling
context: Several initiatives to make Customer Support more efficient.
role: Owned them end to end: planning, development, deployment, stakeholder communication, documentation and demos. Built internal tools that streamlined workflows and centralized key account data.
result: Contributed to cutting ticket reply times from 6 hours to 23 minutes company-wide.

title: Playwright test framework
context: A new end-to-end test framework for the team's product work.
role: Designed and implemented it in Playwright with a modular architecture and parallel execution.
result: Approximately 95% code coverage and significantly shorter test runtimes.

title: GDPR consent enforcement
context: Compliance and data privacy requirements on Blue Apron's e-commerce web platform.
role: Integrated OneTrust, Segment and Google Tag Manager within the Rails backend and React frontend.
result: User consent preferences are enforced through the stack, ensuring GDPR compliance.
